scope: Manual inspection of saved contact sheets at 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2 seconds and full-duration samples at 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 seconds. Video metadata and all frames are decoded separately by verification; no continuous human video-rating claim.
goal_status: PASS: research pipeline and required evaluations completed
motion_quality: Poor: original target cup is not transported according to requested control

controlled.image_quality: Room, table, robot and brown cup remain recognizable; details are softer than real frames.
controlled.target_identity: Original printed blue cup remains near its initial position. A separate blue copy or fragment appears along the upward control; the moving copy does not preserve reliable physical point identity.
controlled.deformation: Moving blue copy becomes a narrow white-blue fragment near the robot shoulder.
controlled.grasp: Gripper stays near the original cup and does not follow the moving copy.
controlled.temporal_consistency: Sampled background is stable without large global jumps. Local changes and occlusions of the copy are physically implausible; low flow-warp error is partly explained by static content.
controlled.after_2_seconds: Original cup and fragment remain approximately fixed through the sampled end of the video.

no_control.image_quality: Background remains recognizable, but the robot gripper develops a human-like hand.
no_control.target_identity: Original blue cup remains visible near its initial position. Additional blue cups and a light-brown fragment appear; a printed motif on some copies cannot prove physical identity.
no_control.deformation: Hand, fingers and duplicated cups change shape and overlap inconsistently.
no_control.grasp: Synthetic hand holds a separate cup rather than transporting the single original cup with the robot gripper.
no_control.temporal_consistency: More local movement than controlled generation; sampled background remains stable. Smooth local motion still violates robot and object geometry.
no_control.after_2_seconds: Synthetic hand and additional cups continue moving despite there being no verified real future beyond the evaluated horizon.

metric_interpretation: AllTracker follows the persistent original cup. Reported ADE/FDE do not measure the hallucinated moving copy. HSV and blue-pixel proxies do not certify shape, printed motif or object count.
limitations: One preselected episode and one seed; no statistical capability claim.
MolmoMotion forecast already differs substantially from real future.
Rigid approximation has mean RMS 73.50 mm; individual contributions are not isolated.
Control uses only observed visible object geometry, with depth holes and partial out-of-frame motion.
Robot arm and gripper geometry have no separately predicted trajectory.
